// Generated by radix - do not edit

class Span {
    var low: Double
    var high: Double

    init(low: Double, high: Double) {
        self.low = low
        self.high = high
    }

    func contains(x: Double) -> Bool {
        return ((self.low <= x) && (x <= self.high))
    }

    func center() -> Double {
        return ((self.low + self.high) / 2.0)
    }
}

extension Span: CustomStringConvertible {
    var description: String { return "Span { low = \(String(describing: self.low)), high = \(String(describing: self.high)) }" }
}
